rotationContract.shapeID: 0 uses accepted base ID; turns use <base>@90|180|270
rotationContract.cellTransform: RuneShapeDef.rotated mapped order normalized to origin; never sorted
rotationContract.bounds: width and height swap each quarter turn

tintRoles.baseRGBA: begin with the exported rgba asset
tintRoles.mixedInk: replace only pixels whose tintMask alpha is greater than zero with resolved ink RGBA; preserve every other base pixel byte-identically
tintRoles.fixedMask: validation and containment authority only; never composite, whiten, or draw this mask

linkContract.selection: touching cardinal occupied cells; shared-edge midpoint top-to-bottom then left-to-right; horizontal before vertical on exact tie
linkContract.handResolution: coarsest endpoint hand: charcoal > brush > fountain
